blueprint.objective: Produce a reviewed one-page management memo explaining quarterly revenue, cost, and margin performance by region from a synthetic financial dataset, incorporating optional qualitative business context.

inputs.name: financials_csv
inputs.description: Path (or inline text) to a CSV with columns region, quarter, revenue, cost. Synthetic data only.

inputs.name: business_context
inputs.description: Optional free-text notes on strategy, known events, or sector conditions that may explain performance.

tasks.responsibility: Read the synthetic financials CSV file (columns: region, quarter, revenue, cost) from the run workspace so its text can be consumed by downstream tasks.

Run data.describe_numeric over the CSV text to obtain row count, the list of numeric columns, and min/max/mean/sum for each numeric column (revenue, cost). These figures are the authoritative numbers the memo must cite.

If business_context is supplied, extract the key strategic themes and caveats that may explain regional performance. If business_context is absent, return empty lists so the memo can proceed without qualitative context.

Using the computed statistics (row_count, numeric_columns, stats), the raw CSV text (for per-region breakdowns that aggregate stats do not cover), and the sector context (themes, caveats), draft a one-page management memo. The memo must: (a) state a headline; (b) give per-region findings on revenue, cost, and margin; (c) list specific, actionable risks; (d) be readable by a non-specialist manager. Every figure quoted must be traceable to the computed statistics or the raw data.

Verify that every numeric figure in the memo matches the computed statistics, that margin is discussed for every region present in the data, and that each risk is specific and actionable. Revise the memo until all criteria pass. Produce the final approved memo.

Combine all results into the final deliverable for: Produce a reviewed one-page management memo explaining quarterly revenue, cost, and margin performance by region from a synthetic financial dataset, incorporating optional qualitative business context.

missing_information: Whether financials_csv is supplied as a workspace file path (requiring files.read_text) or as inline CSV text; the task graph assumes a file path but the PRD is ambiguous.
The expected number of regions and quarters in the synthetic dataset; the memo's per-region findings depend on this.
The exact output format or template for the final memo (e.g., plain text, Markdown, specific section headings).
How margin should be defined (revenue − cost, or (revenue − cost) / revenue × 100) since the PRD mentions 'margin' but the CSV has no margin column.
Whether the review step (review_memo) is a separate human-in-the-loop gate or an automated self-check; the PRD implies a review but does not specify the mechanism.
